segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the quote for the analytics workspace and make sure the seat count and start date line up with what you need.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re still at 42 seats to start, with five of those being admin seats. If onboarding goes well, we may add another 10 in Q2, but not on the initial order.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The quote I sent is for 42 annual seats, March 1 start, 12-month term. It comes to $31,080 for the subscription, plus the one-time implementation package at $4,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I saw. Can you confirm billing is annual upfront? Finance asked if there was a quarterly option, but I think annual is easier if the total stays under $40,000.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, annual upfront is what’s on the order form. Total with implementation is $35,580 before tax. If you need quarterly, I can price it, but there’s a small uplift, so annual is the better fit if procurement is okay with it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Annual should be fine. The only date I want to double-check is go-live. Our team wants training the week of March 11, and then we’d like the dashboard live by March 22.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. We’d kick off March 4, do configuration that week, training on March 12 and 14, and target March 22 for go-live. I’ll put those milestones in the implementation summary.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. On contract terms, our legal team asked for the standard mutual confidentiality language and a 30-day notice window for non-renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, the template already has mutual confidentiality, and I can set the non-renewal notice to 30 days. Renewal would be for another 12 months unless either side gives notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send the updated order form and implementation summary, and I’ll route it today. If purchasing doesn’t have comments, we should be able to sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the clean version in the next hour, with March 1 as the subscription start and March 22 as the target go-live.
